notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: This page does not exist, or your role cannot open it.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: Sign in with your GitHub account. You must be a member of the organization.
signin.error.not_member: Your GitHub account is not a member of the organization.
signin.error.app_missing: The GitHub App does not exist yet. An admin must finish setup first.
signin.error.bad_state: The sign-in link expired. Start again.
signin.error.github: GitHub did not answer. Try again.
setup.title: Set up Sayso
setup.token.body: Enter the setup token. It is the value of SAYSO_SETUP_TOKEN on the server.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.step.app.hint: This step comes first. The other steps open after you sign in with GitHub.
home.title: Reviews
home.empty: No reviews yet. Set a repository to shadow, comment or gate mode.
access.title: Access
access.hint: Roles come from team mappings and direct grants. The highest role wins.
general.title: General
general.hint: Defaults, limits and budgets. Each change keeps its history.
general.invalid: The value is not valid JSON.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Every change to settings, secrets, access and repositories. Nobody can edit it.
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.hint: Checks of the database, Temporal, GitHub and outbound connections.
secret.env.unset: Not set in the API process
repos.title: Repositories
repos.hint: Repositories where the GitHub App is installed. Set the mode of each one.
repos.empty: No repositories yet. Install the GitHub App on one or more repositories.
repos.name: Repository
repos.mode.label: Mode
repos.mode.hint: Shadow runs the agent and posts nothing. Comment posts findings. Gate also fails the check on a blocking finding.
repos.mode.readonly: Only maintainers and admins change the mode.
repos.mode.failed: The mode did not change. Try again.
github.title: GitHub
github.hint: The GitHub App, its installations and the webhook deliveries.
github.app.none: The GitHub App does not exist yet. Create it in setup.
github.installations.none: The App is not installed yet.
setup.app.org.hint: Sayso creates a private App in this organization. GitHub asks you to confirm.
setup.error.bad_state: The App link expired. Start again.
setup.error.github: GitHub did not create the App. Try again.
signin.app_created: The GitHub App exists. Install it on the organization, then sign in.
models.title: Models
models.hint: Providers are model endpoints. Profiles choose the provider and model of each stage.
providers.title: Providers
providers.empty: No providers yet. Add one, then test it.
providers.name: Name
providers.models.hint: Model IDs, one per line. The first one is the test model.
providers.headers.hint: One header per line, as Name: value.
providers.no_tools: This provider cannot do tool calls. Profiles cannot use it.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: Each profile tries its targets in order. A target needs a provider that passed the tool call check.
profiles.prices.hint: Prices are in USD per million tokens.
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.hint: Agent runs reach these servers through the MCP proxy. Tools without the read-only hint stay blocked unless you allow them.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.headers.hint: One header per line, as Name: value. Put secret values in the secret field.
mcp.allow_write.hint: A tool without the read-only hint needs this switch and a matching pattern.
mcp.patterns.hint: One pattern per line, for example ticket_*.
mcp.tools.none: Test the server to list its tools.
repos.mcp.label: MCP servers
repos.mcp.hint: Agent runs of this repository can use the servers that you select. The .sayso.yml file can narrow this list.
repos.mcp.none: No MCP servers exist yet. Admins add them under MCP servers.
feeds.title: Package feeds
feeds.hint: Agent runs get packages from private feeds through the package proxy. In proxy mode, the feed credential stays in Sayso.
feeds.empty: No package feeds. Runs can get only public packages.
feeds.name: Name
feeds.match_urls.hint: One URL on each line, as repository files and lockfiles write it. The run replaces it with the proxy URL.
feeds.repos.hint: One owner/name on each line. Agent runs can read these repositories through the git proxy.
feeds.allowed.hint: One owner/name on each line. Leave empty to allow all repositories.
feeds.inject.warning: Inject mode gives the feed credential to agent runs. The agent can read it and can send it out of the run. Use proxy mode when the package manager supports it.
feeds.inject.confirm: I understand that agent runs get the credential of this feed.
feeds.cache.label: Cache immutable packages
feeds.cache.hint: Sayso keeps package files with a version in their path and checks their SHA-256 on each read.
skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: A round uses the first skill that it finds. The order is the repository skill on the base commit, the Skael set, then the built-in skill.
skills.builtin.hint: Sayso uses this skill when the repository has no review skill and no Skael set applies. You cannot edit it here.
skills.skael.hint: Agent runs pull the review skill from a Skael set. Sayso reports the activations and the round outcomes to Skael.
skills.skael.allowed_sets.hint: One set on each line. Repositories can choose only these sets in .sayso.yml.
skills.skael.hook.hint: The run tells Skael when the agent reads a skill. Turn it off to report activations only with the outcome.
skills.skael.agent_key.hint: A service account key with skills:read, sets:read and events:write. Agent runs get this key. Skael refuses events from a key with a set limit. Give no set limit when the run reports activations.
skills.skael.reporter_key.hint: A service account key with events:write and outcomes:write. It stays in the API.
extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.hint: Extensions are pi packages that agent runs load. Each one has an exact version.
extensions.enabled.label: Enabled
extensions.not_baked: The agent image does not contain this package. Each run installs it from the registry at start, and no cache keeps it. Add it to deploy/agent/extensions.lock and build the image.
extensions.name: Name
extensions.spec.hint: An npm package with an exact version, for example acme-pi-lint@1.4.0.
extensions.secret_names.hint: One variable name on each line. Runs get the values only where the extension is enabled.
extensions.repositories.hint: One owner/name on each line. Leave empty to enable it for all repositories.
images.title: Agent images
images.hint: Repositories can choose an agent image. Runs use the default image when a repository chooses none.
images.empty: No agent images. Runs use the image of the deployment.
images.default.label: Use as the default image
images.name: Name
images.image.hint: An image reference with a tag or a digest.
repos.feeds.label: Package feeds
repos.feeds.hint: Agent runs of this repository get these feeds. .sayso.yml can only remove feeds from this list.
repos.feeds.none: No package feeds allow this repository.
repos.feeds.inject_warning: Agent runs of this repository get the credential of these feeds: {feeds}.
home.hint: Pull requests that Sayso reviews, newest round first.
review.head: Head
finding.title: Title
round.title: Round {sha}
round.shadow: Shadow mode: Sayso posts nothing. The output below is what it would post.
budget.banner: The monthly budget is spent: {spent} of {budget} USD. No new round starts.
repos.review.label: Review
repos.execution.hint: Off: no stage runs a command or writes a file. Toolchain, restore and setup do not run.
repos.threshold.hint: The challenge stage checks each new finding at or above this severity.
run.title: Run: {kind}
run.stage.summary: {turns} model turns, {tools} tool calls, {mcp} MCP calls, {findings} findings
run.events.label: Events
steering.title: Steering queue
steering.hint: Rounds with steering signals and no steering review.
steering.empty: No rounds wait for a steering review.
usage.title: Usage
usage.hint: Tokens and cost of model calls, from the model proxy.
storage.title: Storage
storage.hint: Run payloads and artifacts go to the default store. Old objects stay in their store.
storage.default.label: Use as the default store
storage.name: Name
finding.dismiss.failed: The finding is open again: the dismiss failed.
guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.hint: Guidance adds review instructions to the prompt. It cannot change the tools, the output format, the severity rules or the blocking rule.
guidance.repository.hint: This text goes after the global guidance and before the instructions in .sayso.yml.
guidance.preview.hint: This is the prompt that the next round sends for the stage. It uses the head of the default branch.
config.title: Config
config.hint: The configuration is in PostgreSQL. Export it as YAML, keep it in a repository and apply it again.
config.export.hint: The file has no secret values. Secret fields show the secret name or the environment variable name.
config.import.hint: Select a file or paste YAML. Sayso shows the diff first. Apply makes all changes in one transaction. A section that the file does not have stays the same.
config.diff.none: No changes. The configuration is the same as the file.
repos.effective.label: Effective config
repos.effective.hint: These values apply to a round on {ref}. Each row shows where the value comes from.
checklist.app.hint: Create the App through the manifest flow.
checklist.installed.hint: Install the App on one or more repositories.
checklist.webhook.hint: Sayso has received no webhook delivery yet. Check the ingress.
checklist.provider.hint: Add a provider and run the smoke test until it passes.
checklist.profiles.hint: The review, challenge, reply and fix profiles each need a model target.
checklist.storage.hint: Run the test of one store until it passes.
checklist.repository.hint: Set one repository to shadow, comment or gate.
checklist.round.hint: Open a pull request on a repository that is on.
checklist.hint: Do each step in order. The reviews list shows here when all steps are done.
runner.test.title: Runner test
runner.test.hint: Start a no-op agent run with the default image. The run reports the harness version and stops.
skills.skael.test.hint: The test starts a no-op agent run that pulls the default set in a dry run. Save the settings first.
github.remote.hint: GitHub lists the deliveries of the last 24 hours. Redeliver asks GitHub to send a delivery again.
github.remote.none: GitHub lists no delivery in the last 24 hours.
